observations: Sewing machine on a wooden cabinet stand with foot pedal and treadle-style base.
Machine body is light-colored with visible wear/rust spots and dust; paint looks aged.
Front/side controls and handwheel are visible; no clear brand/model text is readable in the photos provided.
No close-up of needle area, bobbin case, or stitch/working demonstration.
Photos show a full setup (machine + stand), but not accessories like presser feet, needles, or power/adapter (if any).

claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear/dust and some rust/aging on the machine body; no working test or close-ups of functional parts.

risks.risk: Whether it actually stitches properly (timing, tension, feed mechanism) is unknown; photos don’t show a test.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine sewing a straight line on fabric (with needle/bobbin visible if possible), including a close-up of the stitch formation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven to work (worst case: treat like a used machine that may need servicing).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect accessories (presser feet, bobbin, needle, belt/parts) could prevent use or reduce value.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included parts laid out (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, any attachments) and a close-up of the bobbin area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: assume buyer may need to buy missing parts).

risks.risk: Condition of internal components (rust inside, worn gears/bearings) can’t be confirmed from exterior photos.
risks.proof: Open the bobbin/bottom cover and show inside surfaces; also show the underside/drive area clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as exterior-worn and potentially needing maintenance.

risks.risk: Brand/model affects value and parts availability; model is not readable here.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of any nameplate/brand/model label on the machine (front and side), plus any serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price using generic comparable sewing machines (worst case: lowest matching category).

proof_requests: Video of it sewing (straight stitch + turning corners) on fabric, showing stitch quality.
Close-up photos of the needle area and bobbin case (open the cover).
Photos of all included accessories/parts (bobbin(s), needles, presser feet, any attachments).
Clear close-up of the brand/model nameplate/serial label.
response.reason: The item type is visible (treadle/manual sewing machine on a stand), but the key value driver—whether it works well and what exact model/parts are included—is not proven by the photos. Without a working test and readable model/label, a reliable price pick isn’t safe.
